findings.message: The last superframe ends with 7150 bits after its last frame that no frame uses, since no superframe follows to finish a frame begun in them; a decoder drops them.
A frame that began in the superframe before is followed by zero bits up to the bit offset the superframe states, which a decoder skips; the first has 3845 (in the superframe at 0xF8A).
